text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The Champions Cup... Cham...pi...ons...
Cup...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Just how many dirt
champions have
there been?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since her race against Hokko
Tarumae,
Wonder Acute's become
interested in previous
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why we've come to an exhibition
hall near
Chukyo Racecourse before the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Its current theme is: "The Champions
Cup:
Footprints in the Dirt."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh neato. Did you know the Champions
Cup was
once called the Japan Cup
Dirt?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess it must've split from the Japan
Cup at
some point...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean the Champions Cup
used to be
the same as the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup Dirt split off from the
Japan Cup
in order to focus on bringing
in dirt Umamusume
from all over the
world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's how the Champions Cup was born.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a surprise. That must mean
there are
quite a number of dirt
champions, then, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Like Umamusume who got their start in
Oi and
then moved onto the national
stage...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, I think I recognize her...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
She ran against Symboli Rudolf at the
Japan Cup,
right? Her name sounds like
a boxer's name...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And then there's this one. She got
carried away,
knowing she had the
cameras on her, but won by
a huge lead.
She was like a runaway shogun, that

one...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There have been so many wonderful

Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yet...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes settle on a certain column and
a shadow
crosses over her face. "Lifetime
Achievement."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It looks like not everyone knew when it
was time
to throw in the towel.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Seventh place, fifth, seventeenth... They
kept
running even after they could no
longer win...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They must have known they were past
their peak.
Yet as hard as it must have
been... they kept
running with all their
might until the bitter end...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Say, Trainer... Do you think, maybe...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's what made them
champions?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once they earned their crowns, they
defended
them with everything they
had. Even when their
strength began to
fail...
choice_data_list: Yeah, this is the real deal.
Yeah, I believe this is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They dug their fists into the dirt and
hauled
themselves to their feet. They
were out there
showing everyone else
the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why they're still called champions
even
after they retired.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They kept running until they couldn't...
If that's
what makes a champion, then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hm. I thought I'd achieved what I set out
to do,
but... do I still have work to do?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute goes quiet, lost in
thought.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd done everything I could. I
inspired
people to get up and try again.
I raced with
Tarumae and other younger
racers.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I thought I showed them everything they
needed
to know. But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that's not enough... Maybe I still
need to
show them what it's like to get
to the top and
then keep fighting to
hold the position...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: If I still need to show them that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: A true champion... Trainer...
choice_data_list: We've got to make you a true champion, then.
We've got to make you a true champion, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think there's something I still have to

communicate to Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute, I swear I'm going to do even
better this
time!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll have to do the same...
Although I'm
a bit different than before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've realized there's still something I
haven't
showed you yet.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's a deep passion that I'm sure Falco
had, but I
only recently grasped myself...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Today... I'm going to do all I can to get
this
passion across to you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's anyone's race out there today, but I
have
something I want us both to try
together...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's try to become champions that
everyone
looks up to with all their
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to past champions who ran
themselves
to the brink of collapse,
Wonder Acute is still in
great shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why she can't afford to give a
lackluster
performance. She has to do
her history-making
predecessors proud.
